members.name: at
members.doc: When it happened, as an ISO string or epoch milliseconds.

members.name: actor
members.doc: Who did it, shown first in the foreground color.

members.name: title
members.doc: What happened, completing the actor: "merged Checkout redesign into main".

members.name: meta
members.doc: Short context under the title, such as a pull request or a build.

members.name: detail
members.doc: Revealed in place when the row is expanded. Rows without detail are not interactive.

members.name: avatar
members.doc: Portrait for an event by a person.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon for a system event, used when there is no avatar.

members.name: tone
members.doc: Status of a system event. Always say the outcome in the title too, so it never rests on color.

types.name: TimelineProps
types.doc: A vertical activity feed grouped by day, for project history, audit logs, and deploy streams. Use it when order and recency matter; use a table when people need to sort or compare. Day labels stay pinned while their updates scroll, the connecting line draws itself as rows come into view, rows expand in place, and new updates slide in at the top while the rest glide down. Arrow keys move between rows, Enter or Space expands one.

members.name: events
members.doc: Updates in any order; the newest shows first.

members.name: now
members.doc: Reference time for relative labels and day groups, in epoch milliseconds. Pass a ticking clock to keep labels fresh.

members.name: timeZone
members.doc: Time zone for day groups and clock times. Fixed by default so server and client agree.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Height of the scrolling area. Without it the feed grows with the page and reveals on page scroll.

members.name: scrollToNew
members.doc: Scroll back to the top when a new update arrives while the feed is scrolled down.

members.name: headingLevel
members.doc: Heading level for the day labels.
